reden: Yes. The report’s [High] issue explicitly targets StablecoinDEX.sol emergencyWithdraw()/_processWithdrawal(), noting the unchecked subtraction of balances and lack of balance validation, which allows underflow and arbitrary token withdrawals. It describes the same code path, mechanism (integer underflow from unchecked subtraction), attack (calling emergencyWithdraw with more than the user’s balance to drain the contract), and consequences (huge recorded balance, corrupted accounting, complete fund drain). The recommended fix (add a balance check and avoid unchecked arithmetic) would resolve both. Therefore, the audit report detected the same vulnerability.
